name: smwgraphics-blocks-n-bushes
title: Blocks 'N' Bushes
description:
Here's a colorful, simple, and customizable background inspired by the one seen in 1-1 of SMAS SMB3. The palette is mapped in such a way that it should not conflict with either the Status Bar or my latest grassland FG.

As you can see in one of the screenshots, this looks quite nice with my latest grassland set.
